title: Making oneself welcome on every side
odia: ଏ ଘର ମାଉସୀ ସେ ଘର ପିଉସୀ
literal_meaning: A maternal aunt in this house, a paternal aunt in that one.
explanation: The expression portrays someone claiming closeness everywhere while carrying damaging talk between people. The source gloss stresses pleasing both sides and creating discord. Its target is manipulative familiarity, not genuine friendship across households.
meaning_odia: ଦୁଇ ପକ୍ଷରେ ଭଲ ହେବାକୁ ଯାଇ ଏପଟ କଥା ସେପଟ କରି ମନୋମାଳିନ୍ୟ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିବା।
usage_example: A neighbour tells each household that they alone have her sympathy, while repeating complaints from the other. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: ମାଉସୀ and ପିଉସୀ are distinct kinship terms, preserved in the literal rendering. The figurative criticism does not describe a trait of actual aunts or of women generally.
